examples.name: AND Gate
examples.description: Implements a logical AND gate using exception-based transient execution. The output is encoded in the cache state.
examples.code_snippet:
movzx rcx, byte [r13]
add rcx, r14
movzx rdx, byte [rcx]
add rdx, r15
mov dl, byte [rdx]
